QuestInfo.name: Treasures Under Ice
QuestInfo.0: Go to El Nath and speak to the Beggar Guild member, Lan Yi.
QuestInfo.1:
Assuming that Yun Wu and the others went to El Nath and Sleepywood in search of something, you decided to learn if there was something that could only be found in El Nath.
Talk with the residents.
QuestInfo.2:
You let Lan Yi know about the two useful objects Alcaster spoke of. 
One is Qiannian Frost Steel, a metal fused with frost energy to make it stronger than mithril. Another is the Azurite Drop, a special medicine distilled from natural energy.

default.0: I'll take the left, you get the right! We'll meet here again after we talk to anyone who might have seen something!
